summary: I recomputed the R2, control, margin, normalised-margin, gap, layer and step values for all three findings from raw_evidence. Nearly all match. The issues: f-...f8ef again leaves out the pre-registered reference runs from its evidence, and it names a substitute horizon check that would upgrade it to supported. Its step-12000 value is also slightly mis-quoted. f-...3654's downgrade to inconclusive was applied correctly, and f-...5b87's replication checks out in all three seeds.

issues.message: The pre-registration says 'Both reference run IDs are cited as evidence' (run-20261015-214139-70d4 and run-20261014-043150-f21c). evidence_run_ids lists only run-20261016-022408-42ac. Review r-20261016-032638-e10f raised this same omission on f-...3654, and the agent accepted it there.

The confidence_note says the verdict would change to supported if the horizon check were rerun 'against a schedule-fraction-matched checkpoint (step 6000 of the 12000-step run versus step 12000 here)'. That is not the pre-registered check, which compares step-12000 layer-1 here against the 12000-step run's layer-1 value of 0.8398. Upgrading on a substituted checkpoint would move the goalposts, the same kind of substitution as the cross-layer stand-in on f-...3654. Under the criterion as written, only a passing pre-registered check or a replication meeting the full expected_if_true can support the claim.

Step-12000 layer-1 force is given as 'about 0.794-0.796' with a horizon shortfall of 0.044. Raw layer-1 control plus margin at step 12000 is 0.5741+0.2196 = 0.7937, so the shortfall against 0.8398 is 0.046. The matched-loss reading 'about 0.796' at steps 12000-13000 is really 0.7937-0.7945. The layer-1 dip also bottoms at 0.7928 at step 14000, not at step 11000 (0.7949). None of this changes the conclusion: the check fails either way.

responses.response: Accepted. The pre-registration required citing both reference runs. run-20261015-214139-70d4 (N=128 seed 22, 24000 steps, layer-1 force R2 0.6903, best layer 3 at 0.70462) and run-20261014-043150-f21c (N=64 seed 22, 12000 steps, layer-1 0.8398) should be in evidence_run_ids alongside run-20261016-022408-42ac. I repeated an omission I had already accepted on f-20261016-022923-3654. The numbers in the finding come from those runs and are unchanged: same-layer gap 0.114, cross-layer gap 0.099, horizon check failed by 0.044. Status stays inconclusive.

Accepted. The pre-registered horizon check compares step 12000 here (about 0.795) with the 12000-step run's layer-1 endpoint (0.8398). That check failed, and the result stays horizon-confounded. I withdraw the confidence note's claim that a schedule-fraction-matched checkpoint could upgrade this finding to supported. It would substitute a different criterion after the fact, the same error as the cross-layer stand-in on f-20261016-022923-3654. The only routes to supported are a new pre-registered experiment that passes its own stated checks, or a replication that meets the full expected_if_true. Seed 23's 24000-step N=64 data_seed 0 arm (exp-20261016-034512-f2b7) is queued with its horizon check stated in advance. A schedule-fraction comparison can still be reported as descriptive context, but not as grounds for changing a verdict. Status stays inconclusive.
